messages.subject: Sourcing private API key
parts:
I would like to post a public shiny app in showcase mode.  However the app pulls data through the US EIA's API, which requires me to pass my free API key to the function which will download the data.  While the key is free, I really shouldn't leak it to the web.  So I created a directory which contains the API key and am reading the key in like:

      key <- source("./directory/key.txt")$value

Then calling the function with:

     getEIA(ticker1, key = key)

The key isn't shown in showcase mode, so this seems to work.  But if I upload the app to shinyapps.io, will the "directory/key.txt" file be publicly available?
